name: zgeometry_weiler_output_contours_for_clip_mode
description: zGeometry_Weiler::OutputContoursForClipMode routes contour outputs to polygon sets A, B, and C according to clip mode bits and contour type.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry Weiler source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4681a0 validates contourBuffer count/base iteration, empty-buffer success, firstSegment null skip, clipMode bit tests, contour type filters for output sets A/B/C, OutputContourToPolygonSet calls with the correct buffers and polygon sets, zError failure paths, and final success return.

The native clip leaf smoke verifies successful routing of contour type 3 to polygon set A, type 2 to polygon set B, type 5 to polygon set C, skipping a null firstSegment entry, polygon span offsets, polygon counts, and aggregate point-list count.
